thread:
rishi: Heads-up: I'm overhauling the Hello Quickstart auth section to introduce an auth_profile config approach and a tiny local token-broker for dev. Want quick eyes on wording + CI smoke.

emma: Auth_profile? can you paste the example config and env vars? want to make sure copy/paste is accurate.

rishi: Sure. Plan is to ship a small `auth_profile.json` that declares provider, client_id, redirect_uris. Docs will show both the file and env override. Keeping API_KEY in an appendix for backward compat.

```
# auth_profile.json (recommended for private/Dedicated)
{
  "provider": "oidc",
  "issuer": "https://idp.example.com",
  "client_id": "rr-quickstart",
  "redirect_uris": ["http://localhost:3000/callback"]
}

# env overrides (local dev)
REDWOOD_AUTH_PROFILE=./auth_profile.json
REDWOOD_DEV_TOKEN_BROKER=true
```

rishi: Local dev will use `compose.token-broker.yml` which adds `token-broker` service that exchanges codes for session tokens so folks don't need a real IdP during smoke runs.

chloe: For CI, let's add a smoke job that brings up compose + runs `tests/quickstart_tokenbroker_smoke.py`. Use the secret helper to inject a short-lived test client secret. Also add a quick health-check curl to assert the token exchange endpoint returns 200.

rishi: Good call. I'll add `scripts/ci/quickstart_tokenbroker_smoke.sh` that: 1) starts compose with token-broker, 2) seeds test secrets via prow helper, 3) runs smoke test, 4) tears down.

emma: Minor wording nit: call it "local token-broker (dev-only)" and emphasise "never use in production" with a callout. Also add a one-line command to rotate the test secret in the docs: `./scripts/dev/rotate_test_secret.sh`.

chloe: Can we also include a short migration checklist for Dedicated customers? e.g., create OIDC client, update auth_profile, move client secrets to KMS/HSM, run smoke tests, schedule rotation. Keeps support tickets down.

rishi: Will add a "Migration checklist" section and an appendix with the legacy API_KEY snippet. I'll also link the private deploy secrets guide.

docs-bot: PR opened by rishi: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4999 - quickstart: auth_profile + token-broker + CI smoke job

emma: Skimmed PR, left two tiny nits on wording and the sample JSON indentation. Otherwise looks good.

chloe: I'll wire up the CI job after the PR lands. Approve pending CI run.

rishi: Thanks all. Targeting merge tomorrow 09:45 PT after CI green. If anything pops up ping me here. :rocket:
